tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

solution.text:
When $\mathrm{O}^{-}$changes into $\mathrm{O}^{2-}$, energy is absorbed i.e the change is endothermic because $\mathrm{O}^{-}$repels the incoming electron due to similar charge.
H ice, it needs energy to add (accept) the electron. So, electron affinity $\left(\mathrm{EA}_2\right)$ is positive.
